title: Extract model_protocol module (tool-call parsers + reasoning-tag strip)
description: Daud's tool-call parsing and Qwen <think>...</think> stripping are currently inlined in main.py (lines ~95-125 and ~240-250) plus duplicated in voyage/condenser.py (_THINK_RE at line 33). Extract into a new src/daud/model_protocol.py with parse_tool_calls_from_text() that tries Qwen XML format first, then Gemma <|tool_call>call:name{...}<tool_call|> format, returning OpenAI-shape dicts. Add strip_reasoning_tags() that consolidates the <think> regex. Wire into main.py and voyage/condenser.py. Pure refactor; no behavior change on Qwen. Prerequisite for the Gemma 4 migration since Gemma emits a different tool-call wire format.
definition-of-done: 1. src/daud/model_protocol.py exists with parse_tool_calls_from_text(), _parse_qwen_xml(), _parse_gemma_tokens(), and strip_reasoning_tags(). 2. main.py imports from model_protocol instead of defining _XML_TOOL_CALL_RE / _THINK_RE locally. 3. voyage/condenser.py imports strip_reasoning_tags from model_protocol instead of defining _THINK_RE. 4. Unit tests cover: Qwen single-arg, Qwen multi-arg, Gemma single-arg, Gemma multi-arg, numeric arg, empty args, malformed input returns []. 5. Existing tool-call round-trip against Qwen server still works end-to-end.
testing-plan: 1. uv run pytest tests/ -k model_protocol passes all parser cases. 2. grep 'tool_call' src/daud/main.py returns no regex (only imports from model_protocol). 3. uv run daud starts, user requests a tool call (e.g. list_dir), tool executes successfully. 4. uv run daud with a reasoning-heavy prompt: <think> tags are stripped from displayed output.
